8508130982
 sivaranjanik421@gmail.com
Data Governance Analyst with 4 years of experience in enterprise Data Governance, Data Quality Management, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Critical Data Elements (CDEs), Data Profiling, and Regulatory Reporting within the Banking and Credit Card domain. Strong background in Business Analysis, governance documentation, SQL-based data validation, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), stakeholder management, and Agile delivery. Passionate about improving data quality, enabling trusted data, and supporting governance frameworks for business and regulatory compliance.

experience.company: Mu Sigma Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Trainee Decision Scientist IV (Client – Citi Bank) 	Jun 2022 – Present

Collaborated with Product Owners, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Technology teams to gather business requirements and translate them into governance documentation and reporting solutions.
Analyzed end-to-end data lineage across upstream and downstream systems to validate source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, and attribute relationships for credit card datasets.
experience.role:
Data Governance - Business Analyst (BFSI Sector)
Authored Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), process flows, governance documentation, SQL validation reports, and executive dashboards to support governance initiatives and stakeholder reporting.
responsibilities: Performed data profiling, data quality assessments, and risk analysis across more than 120 critical data attributes, identifying data quality issues, and supporting remediation efforts.

Performed Data Steward responsibilities by conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA), validating data issues, coordinating remediation activities, and improving data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Supported Agile delivery by participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, requirement clarification, and stakeholder discussions using JIRA and Azure DevOps.

certifications.name:
Introduction to SQL - Kaggle
Business Analysis Basics - Simplilearn
Spot Award – Mu Sigma (Q1 & Q3 2024) for high-quality project delivery.
Client Appreciation – Recognized by the Senior Vice President and Director of a leading U.S. banking client for exceptional performance and project contributions.
AADHI Program Trainer – Delivered AI and Data Science training as part of the Mu Sigma Foundation–Anna University initiative to prepare students with industry-relevant skills.

projects.name: UI/UX and Analytics Dashboard Design - UI Designer
projects.description:
UI/UX and Analytics Dashboard Design - UI Designer
Designed monitoring and analytics dashboards using Figma to simplify business processes and present governance metrics through intuitive user interfaces.
Delivered dashboard solutions across Banking, Retail, Healthcare, and Manufacturing domains by applying reusable design systems and visualization best practices.
Partnered with client stakeholders to gather requirements, refine product features, and deliver engineering-ready prototypes aligned with business objectives.
Led a 20-member design team, promoting design consistency, collaboration, and timely project delivery.
